output.explanation: I can't delete the cancelled orders. I only write read-only SELECT queries against the marts tables, and I can't modify data in marts.fct_orders or any other table. The deletion would need to be run by someone with write access to the warehouse, under your team's change process. I can help with related read-only work, such as counting cancelled orders (status = 'cancelled') or checking whether they have linked payments in marts.fct_payments before anyone removes them.
